accepted_reason: root review rework: two close-boundary gaps fixed in source; the four-configuration run and its strict aggregation are pending

source.note: filled by the [skip ci] evidence commit that follows the rework run

gaps.previous_behaviour: reader_tts_request_close() called closer_main() on the calling thread when pthread_create() failed, closing the socket and joining the event thread on the owner's thread and leaving no way back
gaps.now: the call changes nothing and fails with MEMORY (native_code = the pthread_create error); the request, its queued events and the connection stay, the state is restored under the callback mutex without reviving a finished request, and the owner may retry
evidence: hook_close_thread_failure_status (real EAGAIN from pthread_create via RLIMIT_NPROC)
hook_close_thread_failure_keeps_request (state, request id, connection, slot and queue depth unchanged)

gaps.previous_behaviour: drop_conn() released the process-wide callback slot before spd_close(), so another handle could take the slot and open a second connection while the old libspeechd event thread was still alive
gaps.now: the slot is kept until spd_close() has joined the old event thread; no lock the callbacks need is held across the close
evidence: hook_close_gate_slot_still_owned (slot still held inside the real close)
hook_close_gate_blocks_other_owner (a second owner cannot connect or speak)
hook_close_gate_destroy_busy (the closing handle is not destroyable)
hook_close_handover_after_join + hook_close_new_owner_connects (the new owner connects only after the join)
hook_close_stale_callback_ignored (a stale callback does not touch the new request)

previous_acceptance.note: kept as the last accepted evidence; superseded by the rework run
